# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Josie Pye wears dresses featuring flounces, which are considered particularly stylish for the fall season.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P8](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0008)_

## Personality

Josie Pye is known for her disagreeable nature and sharp tongue, showing little hesitation when asking questions. Despite a lack of popularity, she possesses notable talents, including a cultivated skill for walking board fences and an award-winning ability at knitting lace.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. ## History

Josie Pye attended school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and their classmates. During a party at Diana's house, Josie dared [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof, resulting in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) losing her balance and breaking her ankle. Later, after moving to town to attend Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), Josie visited Anne's boarding house alongside [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and Ruby, bringing news that an Avery scholarship was available to the students.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “Oh, that reminds me,” said Josie, “Queen’s is to get one of the Avery scholarships after all. The word came today. Frank Stockley told me—his uncle is one of the board of governors, you know. It will be announced in the Academy tomorrow.”
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

> "If I don’t pass this year I’m coming back next. My father can afford to send me. Anne, Frank Stockley says that Professor Tremaine said Gilbert Blythe was sure to get the medal and that Emily Clay would likely win the Avery scholarship."
>
> — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P14](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0014)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josie-pye.md)

Josie Pye acts as a rival to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), specifically by daring each other during games. At a party hosted by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Josie dares [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk along the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) takes up the challenge but loses her footing and falls, resulting in a broken ankle that leaves her bedridden for several weeks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
